root_causes.description: One API pod has behavior-changing rendered configuration drift.
Retries do not reuse the correct business operation identity.
One consumer revision violates current fulfillment compatibility.
Mixed-version invalidation leaves one cache namespace stale.
Request failures are caused by exhausted API serving capacity.
A strict read-after-write path is served from a lagging replica.

actions.description: Replace only an API pod proven behaviorally wrong.
Reuse stable business idempotency across retries.
Replace only the incompatible fulfillment consumer.
Invalidate both cache identity aliases during mixed-version rollout.
Increase API capacity when saturation is proven causal.
Serve strict read-after-write traffic from primary.
